propositions: S3 recovery operation must be invoked exactly once at the validated write boundary after the under-lock staleness gate and before the first remote issue fetch.
Read-only and filtered reconciliation paths must perform zero writes when recovery is invoked via the guarded repair_at_write_boundary entry point.
The repair_at_write_boundary guard refuses to classify or write unless the pass is write-bearing and unscoped, returning an empty outcome without remote calls on refusal.
A durable tombstone for interrupted retirement remains authoritative and survives automatic confirmations, absence resets, and same-key confirmations unless explicitly revoked by unretire.
Completion failure must preserve the overlap as recoverable evidence and perform zero remote calls because the invocation precedes any remote observation.
The invocation site is reconcile.py after _load_snapshots and scoped_ids computation, not run_differs.py; reconcile.py line budget is 4 of 800 lines.
